posts.author: JuhiMahiwal
posts.text: Nasdaq is going almost 24/5! — Nasdaq plans to introduce a new overnight trading session from 9 PM to 4 AM ET , starting December 6, 2026 , subject to SEC approval. That means U.S. stocks could trade for 23 hours a day, 5 days a week with just a 1-hour daily break from 8–9 PM ET for processing. For Indian traders, that could mean far more flexibility to access U.S. markets without waiting for the opening bell. 23-hour U.S. stock trading could be a pretty big shift for global investors.
